name: Sword & Shield Family Pokémon Card Game

releases.name: Sword & Shield Family Pokémon Card Game

description.text: Family Pokémon Card Game, released on 9 July 2021: a set for families with three ready-built 60-card decks led by Cinderace V, Pikachu V and Tyranitar V, with a playmat, a coin, damage counters, Poison and Burn markers, deck bands and a storage box, two battle guides and a first-time guide. A smaller Anytime Anywhere Family Pokémon Card Game, with the Cinderace V and Pikachu V decks and two half-size playmats, came out the same day.
